_doc: Agora document-reasoning instance: 8 smoke / 24 evolve / 24 heldout tasks (frozen stratified split). S = exact normalized match over 24 x k trials. The base harness is the five-tool LangGraph loop; the policy runs in the agora-sandbox container. delta is null so calibrate measures it. w_s = 48 (one trial of 24 x 2) makes a single-trial gain worth 1 before the token-cost term. Retrieval edits are tagged client_tool and tool-output edits output_plumbing because RRSI's fixed vocabulary has no retrieval/tool_plumbing member.
